cards.card_text: Paul fires right back: "God will strike you, you whitewashed wall!" Friend, I've been called crumbly, dusty and blurry, but never a WHITEWASHED WALL.
cards.verse_text: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! You sit here to judge me according to the law, yet you yourself violate the law by commanding that I be struck.”
